supporting_observations.claim: The recurring outbound HTTPS activity is attributed to C:\Program Files\LedgerLink\ledgerlinkupd.exe, which initiated a connection through the proxy to update.ledgerlink.com:443.
The same process and approved update hostname recur at approximately five-minute intervals: successful proxy connections are recorded at 13:35:55, 13:46:07, 13:51:11, 14:00:58, and 14:05:55 UTC.
Two intervening attempts to the same update hostname received proxy errors or denials (503 at 13:40:29 and 403 at 13:55:46), consistent with retries amid intermittent connection failures.

The observed executable, destination, and recurring interval match the organization's inventory description of the approved LedgerLink updater checking update.ledgerlink.com about every five minutes; the evidence supports closing this alert as benign.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT destinations, status, and tunnel byte counts, but do not show the encrypted application content or establish what update data, if any, was transferred (for example, T236-00149 and T236-00242).
The available records show the LedgerLink executable path and its network activity, but do not provide a hash or signature validation for that executable (T236-00147, T236-00152).
claims_not_established: Whether the LedgerLink executable is the authentic, untampered approved binary.
Whether any update was downloaded, installed, or executed during the observed checks.
Whether the proxy failures reflect service-side errors, policy decisions, or another cause.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: WS-MFISCHER-01 accessed a Google Docs document and related Google-hosted resources, which are outside the approved services listed in the environment context (T236-00106, T236-00107, T236-00113, T236-00116, T236-00117, T236-00118, T236-00127, T236-00128).

Separate review: GlobalProtect ran on WS-MFISCHER-01 and contacted Palo Alto Networks for updates. The environment says there is no VPN and remote administration is restricted to WS-IDOYLE-01; these records do not establish that a VPN connection occurred (T236-00276, T236-00277, T236-00281).

Separate review: max.fischer ran WMIC to enumerate running services and later launched encoded PowerShell that queries stopped services; these activities are outside the alerted HTTPS connections (T236-00024, T236-00131, T236-00132).

Separate review: PROXY-SUN-01 initiated a connection to WS-MFISCHER-01 on TCP/135. This source is not the designated remote-administration workstation, and the records do not establish the purpose of the connection (T236-00374, T236-00375, T236-00376, T236-00377).
